scope: Federal and Indiana workforce, apprenticeship, training, reentry, veterans, and career-pathway resources

records.name: U.S. Department of Labor Job Seeker and Training Resources
records.description: Federal Employment and Training Administration hub connecting job seekers to employment, training, American Job Centers, Job Corps, YouthBuild, reentry, dislocated-worker, migrant-worker, and other workforce programs.
records.availability_notes: Programs are delivered through federal, state, and local partners and have separate eligibility rules, enrollment processes, funding, and capacity. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Apprenticeship.gov
records.description: National portal for career seekers, employers, educators, and workforce partners to learn about Registered Apprenticeship, locate open apprenticeship opportunities, find programs and partners, and access implementation resources.
records.availability_notes: Openings are employer- and sponsor-specific. Search results may include registered occupations or partner listings, and applicants must apply directly with the employer or program sponsor. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Indiana Next Level Jobs
records.description: Indiana workforce initiative connecting Hoosiers to tuition-free training through the Workforce Ready Grant and supporting employers through the Employer Training Grant for high-demand occupations.
records.availability_notes: Workforce Ready Grant eligibility, approved programs, participating providers, prior-degree restrictions, and available seats must be checked. Employer Training Grant reimbursement depends on employer and retention requirements. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: WorkOne Northwest Indiana Re-Entry Employment Services
records.description: No-cost employment support for justice-involved people in Northwest Indiana, including career assessment, resumes, interviews, apparel, training and certifications, paid work experience, and transportation assistance.
records.availability_notes: Service area is Northwest Indiana and advisor coverage varies by location. Training, paid experience, transportation assistance, and support funds depend on eligibility and capacity. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Indiana DWD Veterans Services
records.description: State workforce services providing eligible veterans and transitioning service members with individualized career assistance, employment resources, employer connections, training referrals, and related support through WorkOne and veteran employment representatives.
records.availability_notes: Priority and individualized services depend on veteran status, significant barriers to employment, documentation, local staffing, and program eligibility. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Indiana Career Connect
records.description: Indiana's statewide job-search platform offering current job listings, resume-building tools, career information, employer services, and connections to workforce resources.
records.availability_notes: Some features require account registration. Job listings come from multiple sources and can expire or redirect to external applications; users should verify employer and posting details. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Indiana Office of Work-Based Learning and Apprenticeship
records.description: Indiana DWD office supporting Registered Apprenticeships, Certified State Earn and Learn programs, and certified pre-apprenticeships for job seekers, students, employers, educators, and workforce partners.
records.availability_notes: OWBLA supports and certifies pathways but is not a single open-enrollment training provider. Participation depends on individual programs, sponsors, schools, employers, and local partners. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: INTraining Program Search
records.description: Indiana's searchable directory of career-focused education and occupational training programs, searchable by provider, location, program, and related criteria.
records.availability_notes: Directory inclusion does not guarantee admission, funding, current enrollment, or program quality for every user. Verify provider status, costs, outcomes, schedules, credentials, and funding eligibility directly. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Indiana CTE Career Pathways and Programs of Study
records.description: Indiana Commission for Higher Education resource describing state career and technical education programs of study that connect secondary coursework, credentials, college credit, work-based learning, and high-wage career pathways.
records.availability_notes: This is a statewide program framework rather than direct adult enrollment. Actual pathways, courses, credentials, and work-based learning opportunities vary by school, career center, and region. Verified August 6, 2026.
